about.title: About KoalaStuff
about.body1: KoalaStuff is where I collect small tools, browser extensions and experiments that solve problems I run into myself. Some are polished, some are still early, but the goal is always the same: useful tools without unnecessary accounts, tracking or SaaS fluff.
about.body2: Built by a solo developer, one feature at a time. All projects are open-source. If something is broken or missing a feature, GitHub issues are the right place.
about.body3: Some projects are polished, some are experimental, but all are built around real use cases.
about.body4: All projects are released under the MIT license.
trust.title: Why trust these projects?
trust.opensource.title: Open source
trust.opensource.desc: All projects are open source. You can read the code, report issues and suggest improvements on GitHub.
trust.notracking.title: No tracking on this site
trust.notracking.desc: This website has no analytics, no tracking pixels, no cookies and no third-party scripts. What you see is what you get.
trust.realusecases.title: Built around real use cases
trust.realusecases.desc: These tools were built because I needed them myself. No fake demos, no stock-photo testimonials, no inflated user counts.
trust.honest.title: Honest about limitations
trust.honest.desc: Every project page clearly states what works, what does not, and what is still experimental. No promises we can't keep.
devnotes.title: Development notes
devnotes.body: I write occasional dev notes about KoalaStuff projects, browser extension edge cases, Web Audio, self-hosting and implementation details on dev.to.
faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: KoalaStuff is a collection of small open-source tools, browser extensions, desktop apps and experiments built by a solo developer. The focus is on media, self-hosting, browser utilities and everyday automation.
faq.a2: All KoalaStuff projects are built by Timo, a solo developer from Germany. You can find the GitHub profile at github.com/Shik3i.
faq.a3: All projects are open source under the MIT license. You can find the source code on GitHub.
faq.a4: Yes. All KoalaStuff projects are free to use. Some projects are self-hostable if you prefer to run your own infrastructure.
faq.a5: Open an issue on the relevant GitHub repository. Links to each project's repository are on this page.
faq.q6: Do you use tracking or cookies?
faq.a6: No. This landing page has no analytics, no tracking, no cookies and no third-party scripts. Your theme preference may be stored in localStorage — it never leaves your device.
faq.a7: Some projects like KoalaSync are designed to be self-hostable. Check the README of each project for self-hosting instructions.
faq.q8: Why are some projects marked experimental?
faq.a8: Experimental projects are working but may have rough edges, incomplete features, or may change significantly. They are shared publicly because they are useful, not because they are finished.
